worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.summary: Raises a column of molten smoke from the body: tight at the base, flaring a little at the top, it sweeps upward so foes it touches are scorched and may burn; the column rises to its set height and is cut off under a ceiling. Fume style leaves residual heat inside the same column; Burst style loses it for one heavier column.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.use.0: Scorch the foes pressed against you and directly above
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.use.1: Leave the foes pressed against you burning
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.use.2: Use the column's residual heat to push foes off your head and feet
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.use.3: Break up melee and low-air pressure
The column sweeps upward: each foe inside is resolved at most once for about %1$s damage, and the whole column hits at most %2$s foes. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The column shoots up from the body: it flares to %1$s blocks wide at the top and rises up to %2$s blocks above the body's centre within %3$s s; a ceiling cuts it off below.
A target scorched by the column has a %1$s chance to burn for about 40 s: every 5 s it loses 1/16 of its own max health, and its physical damage is halved; Fire types are immune.
Fume style leaves residual heat inside the same column for %2$s s, scalding everyone inside for about %1$s damage every %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.fume.on: Fume style on: column power about x0.88 and its radius about x0.85 with +2 ticks wind-up, but residual heat lingers in the same column and keeps scalding, with cooldown +10 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.fume.off: Fume style off (Burst): the column is about ×1.1 power and widest, with no residual heat and cooldown −2 ticks, for one heavy hit on foes at your feet and in low air.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.growth.0: At level %1$s the column rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks wide, and the burn chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.preference.f: On: about 12%% less column damage, but residual heat lingers in the same column and keeps scalding, with cooldown +10 ticks, for sealing your head and feet. Off: one heavier column with no residual heat and a shorter cooldown, for hitting foes at your feet and in low air.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion waits outside the column's reach; higher opens earlier but lets foes step away first.
With this on, the companion raises Lava Plume when the target is above it or pressing upward, and tall bosses close by are slightly preferred; off keeps the normal attack order.
